contexts.text: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah were so many nations, with whom there was such (outward) worship, and by them are signified so many doctrinal things that were rituals, derived from the outward worship with Gomer. Illustrated.
The destruction of Babel is here treated of (), where Ashkenaz = its idolatrous worship, or outward worship separated from inward... specifically, false doctrinal things.
